blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Legal Aid Office of the Adamson University College of Law on Monday welcomed the acquittal of two of its clients who were arrested on Sept. 21 last year, in connection with the Baha Sa Luneta protest. Lawyer Kathy Panguban, director of the Legal Aid Office, said the acquittal was the result of the grant of their demurrer to evidence, pointing out that the decision confirmed “that no individual should be imprisoned on the basis of nothing more than an accusation, some conjecture or entirely made up evidence.” “Their arrest in relation to the Sept. 21, 2025 anti-corruption […]...
